comment: The fire gate (bugs 058c / 061, game designer 2026-11-15: turn -> raise the weapon -> only then the round, on EVERY operative fire path: auto fire open / cover / corner, quick fire, suppress, targeted object shots, squad and PMC fighters). Read by FireGateRules::GetConfig (Source/CodexTactics/Public/Combat/FireGateRules.h) at game start; the FFireGateConfig defaults mirror these values (test CodexTactics.Combat.FireGate.TuningFileMirrorsDefaults). A round leaves only when the barrel is within the aim cone of the point (AOperativeCharacter::AimConeDeg) and, still in the open, the body within Codex.Fire.BodyArcDeg of it; the aim pose has been up raise_seconds (open) / the cover fire stance cover_raise_seconds (cover); no stance clip plays; a wounded man's torso / hunch is up (InjuredRaise, crouched and in cover too); and the barrel has stayed on the point settle_seconds after a turn. No attempt for eval_gap_seconds = settle again. An anim instance that did not update for anim_stale_seconds holds nothing but the aim. From cover a stance up cover_reach_seconds whose barrel still misses = out of the pose's reach: he steps off the wall (when he may expose himself). A targeted object shot waits at most object_shot_timeout_seconds. enabled 0 = off (CVar Codex.Fire.Gate 0 too). Times s.

dead_zone.comment: Under a platform (SquadFireRules::IsInDeadZone, G007): the shooter's centre (feet + chest_offset_cm) at least min_delta_z_cm above the target's feet, within max_horizontal_cm and at least min_angle_deg down. That geometry holds a shot only when the floor really blocks it: the muzzle trace is blocked, or the floor probe (ground_probe) finds a level edge - two neighbouring floor samples dropping by at least edge_drop_cm toward the target (a platform lip; 0.8 m platforms included). A missed probe (open riser, grating, off a narrow stair) is unknown, never an edge. Read by FireGateRules with this file (game start).

ground_probe.comment: The floor probe between two pairs of feet (CombatGroundQuery, G007; used by the dead zone and the melee shared-ground test). Vertical traces every spacing_cm (at most max_probes, then wider), from up_cm above the higher feet to down_cm below the lower; a probe that misses or lands off the previous floor retries lateral_cm to each side and keeps the floor nearest the previous sample. The melee shared-ground verdict per (enemy, target) is cached cache_s seconds (the flank bite reach, the bite and the close-in step share one probe; no probe at all when the target is downhill or further than the attack range + both capsule radii).

melee_reach.comment: The enemy's blow on uneven ground (EnemyAIRules::CanMeleeOnGround, G007; the real-time AI, the close-in step, the flank detour, the turn-based bite and RampFightSmoke all use it). Feet-to-feet height at most height_cap_cm. Off shared ground (a ledge, a crate, unknown floor) the distance is measured to the target's body point (feet + body_offset_cm), the Godot rule: a 1.1 m ledge stays out of reach. On shared ground (the floor probe rises / falls at most step_max_cm between neighbouring samples: a ramp, a stair) the vertical part blends from that body point to feet-to-feet, fully at slope_full_deg - flat ground is exactly the old rule, no reach jump.

roof_lip.comment: G008b: a kneeling muzzle (85 cm) on a roof hits the parapet (~100 cm, 20 cm thick) or the roof slab, while the sight line starts past that rim, so the team sees a man on the ground and no round leaves. When the shooter stands at least min_drop_cm above the target and the blocked hit is within lip_cm with its top inside the band around his feet, the shot is retried from past_cm beyond the rim's near face. past_cm 80 clears the parapet and stays inside a 4 m wall; a tall wall (top above band_above_cm) and a man on the ground are not retried. Read by FireGateRules with this file; SquadFireRules::MayClearRoofLip.
